origins.neoorigins.water_mage.descriptio: Yiwen ufellaḥ yesɛan ṣṣifa n lebḥeṛ, yesseḥla-d lebḥeṛ, yesɛan lḥal deg imukan n lebḥeṛ.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_tidal_wave.d: ?eǧǧa-d taɣect n waman ɣer zdat, ḥemmlen-t ṛebɛa n lexṛif, iɛdawen ; ssefna-d tis snat.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_healing_mist: Serreḥ-ed yiwet leɛfu n teswiɛt iwakken a k-yesseḥlu 6 HP d iberdanen i gzedɣen.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.name: Alwaṭus
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.desc: Ṛṛuḥ s wayes ara tfehmem ɣer waman i dayem.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_moisture_reg: Axaṭer a d-yefk leḥnana m'ara d-yaweḍ deg waman.
?ef wannect-agi i d-yețțak lexṣaṣ deg unezṛuf akk-d imuḍan, ṣṣifa-k tazmert n igenni.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.name: ?effli
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.desc: ?ef waman, tezmert-ik tețțawiḍ seg waman, mačči d aɛekkaz.
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.name: Ticmatin times
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.description: Yiwet n tmes ițțuɛeǧben di tmes, iḍeggeṛ times, ițwagezmen ɣer tmes, ițṛuẓu wid i kkun-id-yewten, times ur kkun-izmir ara a kkun-ixuṣṣṣen, meɛna aman-agi d aman i kkun-id-ițeffɣen.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.name: Taɣect n tmes
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.desc: Aql-i ṛebɛa tmes i tețmuquleḍ ; a t-id-tefkiḍ ṛebɛa tmes.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_inferno_burst: Serreḥ-ed imeslayen n tmes i d-yețțak iɛdawen meṛṛa i gzedɣen.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_flame_cloak.d: Wid iḥekkmen ad ṭṭfen 30% seg cceṛ i gexdem times.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fire_immunity: Leḥṛam n tmes, leḥwayeǧ akk-d leḥṛam. Lava ț-țmeslayen kan.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_water_weaknes: Mkul sennig, m'ara d-yaweḍ aman neɣ m'ara d-yețwaxleq.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.name: Lǧiha n tmezduɣt
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.descri: Laẓ yesɛan lǧețțat 50% si lǧiha n leḥzen.
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.name: Mage
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.description: Yiwet n wemdan yesɛan tazmert iwakken a d-iḍeggṛen waḍu, a d-yawi taḍuṛit iḍuɛen ɣer igenni, a d-yefk tafat am waḍu, ma d lǧehd am tegzirt.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_wind_charge.de: Sṭeggiḍ aḍu iwakken aț-țesseɣli ɣef ddemma n waḍu.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.name: Uḥal
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.desc: Kkset aɣeṭṭas n lebḥeṛ i d-yețțak aṭas n ccwal ɣef ṛebɛa seguṛt i d-yețțak ṛebɛa nniḍen.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.name: Ilfan
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.descri: Ɛuzz-ik igenni ɣer wemkan n igenni.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_no_fall_damage: Ɣef waḍu-inek, ur teɣliḍ ara cceṛ.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.name: Zefir
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.descrip: ?ef waḍu n tgejdit n tnefsit, țțawi-d 20% iṣubb ɣer ifassen.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.name: ?ṣaf
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.desc: ?ef wannect-agi, ḥemmlet am akken ur nesɛi ara lqebṭan. ?ef wannect-agi, ḥesbeḍ aqcic-agi iwakken aț-țeṭṭfeḍ uẓumm.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.name: Timwim n tneflit
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.descri: - 2 ulawen (-4 taxaṭer HP). Lǧețța n igenni ur tebni ara iwakken ad yexdem.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.name: Lfayda
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.name: Leɛmeṛ n leɛqel
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.descript: d aɛdaw n iger n lǧiha i d-yețțaken lfayda ; ṭṭfet iɛdawen ɣer lḥebs neɣ a ten-yesseɣli, lameɛna lǧețța-k ur tețțuɣalem ara seg wakal.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.name: Leɛqel
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.descr: Tmes yiwen wemkan ṭṭlam i gɣelqen ɣer teswiɛt ṭṭlam ɣef ṭṭmeɛ. Imdanen iǧehden iǧehden țwaḍeggṛen ɣer wexxam-is ṛebɛa senniḍen.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_repulse.de: ?ef wannect-agi, ḥemmlen-d lḥaǧa i d-yețțak lǧiha i gzedɣen imezdaɣ meṛṛa.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_levitation: ?uṛ-wat lmuqeddem-agi : ḥadret a d-yekker fell-asen lmuqeddem (Amɛellem I). Axaṭer uqbel, a t-tețbecciṛ d aqcic yesɛan lefhama.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_unmoored.d: Awi 75% nniḍen a d-yawi ddnub ; leɛqel-ik tesɛiḍ aț-țfehmeḍ.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.name: Aḍu
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.desc: ?ef wannect-agi, tezmert-ik tesɛiḍ aṭas, mačči d aɣṛum-ik.
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.name: Tafat n ṭṭlam
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.descrip: Yiwet n ɛeṣṣaṛ i gɛeǧben tili, yesɛan tazmert n ṭṭlam akk-d ṭṭlam. Di yiḍ, tețwaḥseb d tezmert-ik, ma d ṭṭeq-iț tezmert-ik tețmeslay.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_or: ?erreḍ ṭṭlam ɣer wemkan-ik i d-yețțak ṭṭlam d aderɣal ger iɛdawen i gzedɣen. Armi ț-țilawin i gxeddmen yid-wen.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_st: Tebɛeḍ ɣer wanda tețmuquleḍ, armi d-tebɛeḍ 24 sblac. A sen-d-tefk snat n tnac, ṛebɛa-nni snat n tmes.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_night_vis: Walit ț-țideț di ṭṭlam s ṭṭlam. Tbeggiḍ-ed aț-țesɛum aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (iwumi yella K).
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_cl: Ɣef wannect-agi i k-d-ifehmen seg wass n 40% si lǧehd-nsen.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_sunburn.d: Sṭerḥbet yiwen n cceṛ mkul sennig deg yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_light_sen: 30% yesɛan azal, atan ț-țafat i d-ițbanen allen-ik.

Axaṭer tazmert ur nexdim ara aṭas
neoorigins.configuration.ocean_origins.d: Axaṭer ddnubat n ddnub mkul sennig
Imezwura yesɛan lfayda n tegzirt n leɛtab
neoorigins.configuration.sun_damage.helm: Axaṭer tikli n cceṛ i gețwaxleq
